_comment: Substack slug -> YouTube video ID, for the 'Watch on YouTube' link and timestamp-linked chapters on each episode page. No deterministic way to derive this (YouTube assigns IDs at upload time with no reference back to the Substack slug) -- hand-maintained, add a new entry when a new episode uploads to YouTube. NOTE: publishing-pipeline/scripts/youtube/apply_title_backfill.mts and apply_tags_backfill.mts each carry their own independent copy of this same video-ID list (keyed by video ID -> title, not slug -> ID) -- not unified with this file in this pass, so a new episode needs the ID added in both places until that's reconciled.
